topic: Iowa carpenter Dale Schroeder, two pairs of jeans, left almost $3M that sent 33 small-town kids to college (KCCI/CBS 2019)
title: He Owned 2 Pairs of Jeans. He Sent 33 Strangers to College #truestory
description:
#truestory #iowa #carpenter

"How much are we talking about, Dale?"

Dale Schroeder was a carpenter in Iowa who owned two pairs of jeans and a rusty Chevy. When he died, his lawyer found out what he'd saved. It sent 33 small-town kids to college, debt-free.

#mayorofmainst #truestory #payitforward

Source: KCCI, CBS News, FOX 32 (July 2019)

Retold with AI voice & visuals
fact_notes: KCCI via ABC7 (2019-07-18): Iowa carpenter, two pair of jeans (work jeans, church jeans), old rusty Chevrolet truck, 33 strangers to college; grew up poor, never went to college, never married, same business 67 years; Steve Nielsen friend: 'He was that kind of a blue-collar, lunch pail kind of a guy. Went to work every day, worked really hard, was frugal like a lot of Iowans.'; died 2005, no descendants; 'He wanted to help kids that were like him that probably wouldn't have an opportunity to go to college but for his gift'; almost $3 million; 33 people free; got together 14 years after his death around his old lunch box; Kira Conard 'Dale's Kids', at her high school graduation party preparing to tell friends she wouldn't go to college, had the grades not the money, phone rang, 'I broke down into tears immediately'; 'All we ask is that you pay it forward... You can't pay it back, because Dale's gone, but you can remember him, and you can emulate him.' FOX 32: friend and lawyer Stephen Nielsen; grew up in the Depression, father abandoned family at an early age; worked until 82, died at 86; full ride tuition, books, fees, room and board; committee sent gas money to students who couldn't afford to get to interviews. Upworthy (CBS News quotes): carpenter from Ames; 'Finally, I was curious and I said, How much are we talking about, Dale? And he said, Oh, just shy of $3 million. I nearly fell out of my chair'; Kira: 'For a man that would never meet me, to give me basically a full ride to college, that's incredible. That doesn't happen.' Assumed: looks, clothes, the law office, the car at the gas station, the group photo, the 2019 gathering picture.
